subject: Deep sea skates
topic: This flat fish flying over the seafloor isn't a stingray. It's a skate.
script:
This flat fish flying over the seafloor isn't a stingray. It's a skate.
Skates look a lot like stingrays, but they're different.
Most skates don't have a stinging spine in their tail.
And while many rays give birth to live young, skates lay eggs in tough cases.
When those empty cases wash up on beaches, people call them mermaid's purses.
Skates live all the way into the deep sea. One of these was filmed nearly two and a half kilometers down.
Their spotted patterns break up their outline, so predators have a harder time seeing them.
Watch closely and you can see them breathe, as water flows in and out.
Skate or ray: could you tell the difference?
pkg_title: It's NOT a Stingray… It's a Deep-Sea SKATE 🐟 #Shorts
